package secretmanager

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/edgelesssys/continuum/internal/oss/auth"
)

func TestTRRefreshIsBounded(t *testing.T) {
	sm := New(func(ctx context.Context, _ auth.Credential) (string, []byte, error) {
		deadline, ok := ctx.Deadline()
		if !ok || time.Until(deadline) > 2*time.Minute {
			t.Fatal("missing refresh deadline")
		}
		return "synthetic", []byte("synthetic"), nil
	}, true)
	if err := sm.ForceUpdate(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestTRRefreshCancellation(t *testing.T) {
	sm := New(func(ctx context.Context, _ auth.Credential) (string, []byte, error) {
		<-ctx.Done()
		return "", nil, ctx.Err()
	}, true)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	cancel()
	if err := sm.ForceUpdate(ctx); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if sm.secret != nil {
		t.Fatal("failed refresh published a secret")
	}
}
